2014_spells.concordant-crossing.descript: You briefly transport yourself to the Astral Plane and back again. As part of the same action used to cast this spell, you can teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.
2014_spells.concordant-crossing.effectSu: Teleport up to 60 ft to a space you can see
2014_spells.concordant-crossing.fullDesc: Using 1 action, as part of the same action used to cast this spell, you can teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. You briefly transport yourself to the Astral Plane and back again. The effect lasts for 1 minute.
